name: Liz Taylor
source:
American.
The protagonist's mother
A romance novelist who is serialized in the Manhattan Times.
After the divorce she raised her daughter all by herself.
Occasionally she gets reckless and doesn't come home until late at night...
She thinks it might be fun to experience love again someday.
